title: St. Peter's Basilica
scope: The standing Vatican basilica with Maderno’s facade and stairs, the nave and transepts, Michelangelo and della Porta’s great ribbed dome with lantern, subsidiary cupolas, and the connected sacristy.
limitations: The facade rhythm, two clocks, thirteen roof statues, dome ribs and lantern are modeled. Sculptures, inscriptions, lettering and fine decoration are represented at landmark scale.

Local rooftop fittings, stair risers, subsidiary dome profiles and some outer window details are approximate. St Peter’s Square, the separate colonnades, the Apostolic Palace and basilica interiors are outside the selected extent.
